results.original_name: ドラゴンボール超 ビルス
results.overview:
When Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens in search of a worthy rival, Goku and his friends face an epic battle to stop him from destroying Earth.

Remastered and re-edited version of Dragon Ball Super.
results.name: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus

results.original_name: ホタルの嫁入り
results.overview: Satoko Kirigaya has everything a noblewoman could want—except time. With her life running out, she’s determined to marry well and make her father proud. But when a ruthless assassin kidnaps her, she makes a desperate offer: “Marry me, and we’ll have it all.” Shinpei Goto accepts, only to become dangerously obsessed. Now Satoko must choose between duty and a love that could consume them both.
results.name: Firefly Wedding

results.original_name: 彼女の友達
results.overview: For the first time in my life, I have a girlfriend. But her friend tempts me with a body that's so seductive... What would you do if your girlfriend's friend came on to you like this?
results.name: My Girlfriend's Friend

results.original_name: ダークサモナーとデキている
results.overview: Amona, a dark summoner and demi-human girl who's too weak to resist her desires, and Roni, an overly serious priest! Roni welcomes Amona as a new member to his adventuring party. Everyone expected the two would clash and become sworn enemies. But, to their surprise and on their first day together, they have a one-night stand...!
results.name: I'm Dating a Dark Summoner

results.original_name: テムパル～アイテムの力～
results.overview: Escape everyday life in SATISFY, a VR game where players earn real-world fame and fortune. One player, Grid, can't seem to catch a break in the game or in real life. That all changes when a challenging quest leads him to becoming the heir to a legendary blacksmith. His stats are reset to zero, but he's leveling up and crafting some seriously god-tier goods.
results.name: Overgeared

results.original_name: 朱色の仮面
results.overview: Apprentice mask maker Peru should have known the perils of The Masks. Possessed by the Mask of the Warrior God, he unintentionally kills his friends and his master, the legendary Gaston Roux. Wracked with guilt, Peru vows to destroy every mask his master created before tragedy strikes again. As his mission takes him around the world, Peru makes friends, battles enemies, and reckons with his sins.
results.name: The Vermilion Mask

results.original_name: 追放されたチート付与魔術師は気ままなセカンドライフを謳歌する。 ～俺は武器だけじゃなく、あらゆるものに『強化ポイント』を付与できるし、俺の意思でいつでも効果を解除できるけど、残った人たち大丈夫？～
results.overview: Rein spent years enhancing his guildmates’ gear with magic, only to be expelled the moment he enchanted everything. Unfazed, Rein steals back his magic, pours it into his own sword, and makes the best of his newfound freedom as he sets off as an adventurer. Along the way, Rein gathers a band of fellow outcasts and together they fight monsters and carve out their place in an enchanted world.
results.name: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life

results.original_name: 生徒会にも穴はある！
results.overview: In a student council filled with weirdos, one new member is about to have a hell of a school year! Mizunoe Ume just wanted to avoid repeating a grade when he joined the student council. After all, it seemed like an easy fix to his current academic problems. But then, he met his fellow council members. Each of them is eccentric in their own way—one's an airhead, another's scary, one's secretly a pervert, but all in all, they're just really weird! Yet somehow, they're also oddly cute and endearing. Which means Mizunoe is stuck with them and all the chaos they bring to the table. Get ready for a slice-of-life story that's irresistibly charming, quirky, and a little bit naughty!
results.name: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!

results.original_name: 貸した魔力は【リボ払い】で強制徴収
results.overview: In a world where magical Gifts determine your destiny, Lent’s rare ability lets him lend his magic points to others. He forms an adventuring party called the Skypiercers with his friends, helping them become powerful heroes, only to be later cast aside as dead weight. Furious, Lent awakens the true power of his Gift: Forced Collection, the power to repossess magic. His revenge starts now.
results.name: Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I'll Cash In with a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest!

results.original_name: 信者ゼロの女神サマと始める異世界攻略
results.overview: An isekai fantasy where an ordinary gamer reincarnates without special powers, teams up with a minor goddess, and rises from the weakest to the strongest in a new world.
results.name: Full Clearing Another World Under a Goddess with Zero Believers

results.original_name: マウスカーソルで現実を操作できるようになったので、女の子をいっぱいクリックしまーす
results.overview:
One day during class, Takumi— an otaku — notices his mouse cursor has sprung out of the screen.

Panicked, he asks his childhood friend Mone, sitting next to him, to take a look, only to be brushed off...

Once Takumi realizes he could actually control it himself, he uses the mouse cursor— visible only to him— to slip it in between Mone's clothes and starts clicking away...

Here's Japan’s (probably) first new genre of romcom, "Clicking Away at a Gyaru Who's Mean to Otakus with a Mouse Cursor"!
results.name: Now That I Can Control Reality With A Mouse Cursor, I'm Gonna Click Away On The Girls!

results.original_name: 人付き合いが苦手な未亡人の雪女さんと呪いの指輪
results.overview: Satoru Takahashi, a young man who inherits his late father's apartment complex in a modern world where humans and yokai (supernatural creatures) coexist.
results.name: The Lonely Snow Widow and the Cursed Ring

results.original_name: どうも、好きな人に惚れ薬を依頼された魔女です。
results.overview: Rose, a lone witch who lives quietly by the lake, is asked by the knight she secretly loves to brew a love potion—for someone else. Though heartbroken, she cannot refuse him, choosing instead to treasure the fleeting time they spend together gathering ingredients. And as the days quietly slip by, Rose finds herself clinging to each shared moment, dreading the day the potion is finally complete.
results.name: Hello, I Am a Witch and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion!

results.original_name: 塩対応の佐藤さんが俺にだけ甘い
results.overview: Sato may be the most beautiful girl in school but she's also the coldest, never smiling at anyone. When her classmate Oshio spots her at a café, he learns Sato's secret: she's actually just shy and clumsy. As Sato and Oshio bond over their shared interests in photography and desserts, a sweet romance starts to blossom between two socially awkward people.
results.name: The Cold Sato-san Is Only Sweet to Me

results.original_name: ロメリア戦記
results.overview: Victory over the Demon King should have been Romelia’s triumph. Instead, her fiance, Prince Henri, breaks off their engagement and sends her home in disgrace to a province in ruins. With no aid in sight, Romelia vows to raise an army, rebuild the ruined towns, and restore a struggling kingdom as new conflicts arise. The war may be over, but her story’s just begun.
results.name: Romelia War Chronicle

results.original_name: PSYREN -サイレン-
results.overview: One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious red phone card. Days later, his childhood friend, Sakurako Amamiya, who possessed the same card, suddenly vanishes. In search of her, he's drawn into rumors of a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances by a secret organization known as Psyren. When he accesses the group, a deadly game that changes his fate forever begins.
results.name: PSYREN

results.original_name: 魔法騎士レイアース
results.overview: A school trip to Tokyo Tower turns into a battle for another world when Hikaru, Umi, and Fuu are summoned to Cefiro! With Princess Emeraude captured, the magical world teeters on the brink of collapse. To save her, the three girls must awaken their powers, become the Legendary Magic Knights, and face deadly enemies before Cefiro is lost forever!
results.name: Magic Knight Rayearth

results.original_name: 凶乱令嬢ニア‧リストン 病弱令嬢に転生した神殺しの武人の華麗なる無双録
results.overview: A dying girl is saved when a fallen warrior’s soul is placed in her body, giving her new life, healing powers, and an unstoppable thirst for battle that brings chaos in its wake.
results.name: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden

results.original_name: 目覚めたら最強装備と宇宙船持ちだったので、一戸建て目指して傭兵として自由に生きたい
results.overview: When office worker Takahiro Satou awakens inside his favorite sci-fi game, he finds himself commanding a powerful spaceship. He takes to the stars as Hiro the mercenary, battling enemies and gathering allies along the way. But he soon faces a big problem: he has no home and, more importantly, no carbonated drinks! There's only one thing to do…buy himself a house on a planet!
results.name: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!

results.original_name: マジカル★エクスプローラー
results.overview: Reborn in his favorite bishojo game, Kousuke gets the worst role possible: the forgettable sidekick. But armed with his knowledge of the game and this world’s largest mana pool, he might even surpass the hero! Now Kousuke must rewrite his fate and battle his way toward the heroines’ happy endings!
results.name: Magical Explorer
